purpose: Determine whether the exact first-half full-update direction functionally explains the retained second-half F-minus-O improvement through immediate parameter effects, propagated state effects, or their joint tangent.
activation_dependencies: Arm B is terminal or execution occurs on separately leased hardware under a corrected host-specific exclusivity policy.
nncp_open_integrated_midpoint_segment_replay_65536_q0_v1 passes every forward, loss, backward, update, rebuild, second-half, repeat, resource, and dependency gate.
The complete open F and O trajectories are byte-identical to their captured oracle artifacts.
The population, model, initial state, optimizer state, update direction, permutation, arithmetic, build, and runtime root are content-addressed.
No closed LibNC or NNCP runtime participates in treatment execution beyond immutable captured oracle inputs.

target_definition.population: All 65,536 frozen second-half events in original segment and event order.
target_definition.loss_evaluator: A content-addressed scalar software implementation with frozen correctly-rounded logistic semantics; host libm is forbidden.
target_definition.zero_denominator_rule: If oracle gain is not strictly positive or target delta energy is zero, the receipt is invalid rather than assigned an arbitrary recovery value.

parameter.definition: J_theta[u] times delta_theta_F, linearized at the O midpoint parameters and O midpoint state, with state perturbation forced to zero.

state.definition: The complete propagated J_state[u] times delta_state_F, linearized at the O midpoint parameters and O midpoint state, with parameter perturbation forced to zero.
state.state_scope: Every decoder-visible recurrent, attention, cache, and other future-affecting midpoint state represented by the integrated replay contract.

joint.definition: parameter_jvp[u] + state_jvp[u] under the same O tangent point and frozen reduction order.

shifted.definition: The joint tangent computed after applying the preregistered content-addressed cyclic segment permutation to first-half update directions while preserving event positions and norms.

negated.definition: The exact sign-negated joint update direction, including both parameter and state components, with no refitting or rescaling.

no_fit_rules: Every tangent uses unit scale exactly as produced by the full midpoint oracle.
No scalar calibration, least-squares projection, clipping search, rank search, layer search, segment selection, sign selection, temperature, or normalization is fitted on the 65,536-event population.
The shifted permutation and negation operation are frozen before any treatment metric is observed.
Parameter, state, and joint arms consume identical events and truths in identical order.
The joint input must equal the elementwise source-order sum of the separately materialized parameter and state JVP vectors before loss evaluation.
Any arithmetic-, population-, direction-, state-scope-, or scale-affecting correction requires one versioned correction-only successor.

metrics.cosine_alignment: dot(arm_jvp, delta_logit_target) / sqrt(dot(arm_jvp, arm_jvp) * dot(delta_logit_target, delta_logit_target))
metrics.thirds: Three contiguous event-order partitions whose boundaries are fixed by the population manifest before execution.
metrics.positive_segment_fraction: Number of frozen segments with positive truth-path gain divided by the complete segment count.
metrics.accumulation: Scalar non-contracted fixed source order under FE_TONEAREST, with finite operands and outputs required.

parameter_dominant_pass.condition: The principal joint gate passes; parameter truth_path_gain_recovery_fraction is at least 0.5; parameter truth_path_gain_bits is at least state truth_path_gain_bits; and parameter strictly beats shifted and negated controls on truth-path gain and logit-energy recovery.
parameter_dominant_pass.authorized_successor: One compact tied parameter adapter that approximates the exact update direction; no parameter cloud.

state_dominant_pass.condition: The principal joint gate passes; state truth_path_gain_recovery_fraction is at least 0.5; state truth_path_gain_bits exceeds parameter truth_path_gain_bits; and state strictly beats shifted and negated controls on truth-path gain and logit-energy recovery.
state_dominant_pass.authorized_successor: One stateful decay or retention adapter that preserves the measured propagated state effect; do not enlarge a static projection.

joint_only_pass.condition: The principal joint gate passes; both parameter and state truth_path_gain_recovery_fraction are below 0.5; and the joint treatment passes.
joint_only_pass.authorized_successor: One joint parameter-state adapter with the same frozen interaction boundary.

subscale_with_state_signal.condition: Joint recovery misses 0.5, but state recovery is positive in every third, beats controls, and predicts later rather than immediate gain.
subscale_with_state_signal.authorized_successor: One stateful compact student or retention mechanism; exact primitive porting pauses.

subscale_without_state_signal.condition: Joint recovery misses 0.5 and neither parameter nor state arm demonstrates control-separated transfer.
subscale_without_state_signal.authorized_successor: Retire this NNCP-to-MIDAS interface and preserve the open parent evidence; do not tune rank, scale, or layer subsets.

causal_control_failure.condition: Joint does not strictly beat shifted and negated controls on truth-path gain and logit-energy recovery.
causal_control_failure.authorized_successor: None; causal alignment is unproven and the interface is retired.

implementation_failure.condition: Integrated parity, complete population, finite arithmetic, repeat, resource, or dependency evidence fails before a valid metric decision.
implementation_failure.authorized_successor: At most one correction-only implementation successor at the first divergence; scientific verdict remains none.

claim_boundary.pass_proves: A no-fit first-order tangent recovers a specified fraction of the retained full midpoint functional effect on the bound population and separates from causal controls.
pass_does_not_prove: A compact adapter preserves the effect.
Any finite arithmetic archive is smaller.
Package, memory, runtime, determinism, or Hutter Prize eligibility.
